# The book the retarget route starts from: HKD settled in, and a bill left
# unpaid for tests/fixtures/fx_hkd_spent_by_retarget.txt to settle.
#
# A USD invoice is settled into `Assets:Bank:HKD`, putting 1,560.00 HKD in the
# book at 0.172 with an available balance to match, and a 200.00 USD bill is
# posted against it and left open.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_what_a_settlement_brought_in.py.

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Vendor"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-HKD-IN"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05

		date: 2026-01-05

		action: "Hours"

		quantity: 2
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05

	payment:

		Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
